tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Markets this account can read, each with the durations that have forecasts now, and what it follows. Page with page.nextCursor.

tools.name: get_outlooks
tools.description: Current forecasts for one market; one market per call by design, so data is not pulled in bulk. Choose durations (exact or a range) and optionally direction, confidence or target filters. At most 6 durations and 72 forecasts per call; calls can run in parallel.

tools.name: get_performance
tools.description: How often past forecasts touched their target, by confidence level and period. Pass probabilityPercent for the matching row (headline).

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Recent example forecasts with their outcomes; not a full record.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Remaining allowances, what one get_outlooks call returns, and this connection's permissions, canFollow and expiry. Uses no allowance.

tools.name: follow_market
tools.description: Follow a market for this account. Check canFollow in get_usage first. Replacing a followed market is allowed once every 30 days: ask the user, then call with confirmReplacement true.

tools.name: unfollow_market
tools.description: Stop following a market; its data stops being readable. Check canFollow in get_usage first.

tools.name: get_glossary
tools.description: What every Kunkafa term and number means and how to read them. Call once before explaining results. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_account_links
tools.description: Links to create an account, sign in and manage connections.
